{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
# Only include completed orders that are not QA
real_completed = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
